name: claude-cycling-mcp
description: Describe a structured cycling session once; render it to a MyWhoosh .zwo and a Garmin Connect workout.
long_description:
Writing a structured bike session means either clicking blocks around in a graphical editor or hand-writing XML — and the two platforms want different formats, so the same session gets built twice.

This server takes one flat, hand-editable workout spec and emits both files. Power is written in watts or % FTP; steady blocks, ramps, free rides and repeated sets are all supported, along with per-block cadence and on-screen messages.

**Offline.** No network calls, no credentials, no uploads; filesystem access is limited to the server's own coaching database and to explicit out_path writes. `describe_spec` returns a block table with computed watts and estimated IF/TSS so a session can be checked before it is rendered, and `verify_garmin_upload` compares an uploaded workout against what was actually sent.

**Uploading lives in the bundled skills**, because it needs auth, a browser, and a human in the loop — a MyWhoosh export spends a finite slot credit. The skills ship as MCP prompts, so they are available from the prompt menu as soon as the server is connected.

**A coach layer on top.** The server keeps the athlete's file — profile, dated FTP/weight/HR history, objectives, imported Garmin activities and planned sessions — in a local SQLite database at ~/.claude-cycling/coach.db, and computes training load, CTL/ATL/TSB and plan-versus-actual compliance from it. It never talks to Garmin itself: the model fetches from the Garmin MCP and passes the payload through unchanged.

tools.name: validate_spec
tools.description: Check a workout spec and report every problem found

tools.name: describe_spec
tools.description: Show the session as a block table with computed watts, duration, IF and TSS

tools.name: render_zwo
tools.description: Render the spec to a MyWhoosh-compatible .zwo file

tools.name: render_garmin
tools.description: Render the spec to a Garmin Connect workout payload

tools.name: check_garmin_payload
tools.description: Check a composed payload against the digest render_garmin issued, before uploading

tools.name: verify_garmin_upload
tools.description: Compare an uploaded Garmin workout against the payload that was sent

tools.name: verify_mywhoosh_import
tools.description: Check a MyWhoosh builder header against the session that was rendered, before export spends a credit

tools.name: verify_mywhoosh_library_entry
tools.description: Check a MyWhoosh library card against the session that was exported

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Identify this server: version, where it is loaded from, what it serves, and where its coaching database lives

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Fetch a bundled procedure by name — the two upload flows, or coaching

tools.name: spec_schema
tools.description: Return the workout spec's JSON schema and authoring notes

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the athlete's file: profile, current FTP/weight/HR, and what is still unknown

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Set athlete fields: availability, equipment, constraints

tools.name: log_ftp
tools.description: Append a dated FTP, or a 20-minute test converted at the 0.95 convention

tools.name: log_weight
tools.description: Append a dated weight in kilograms

tools.name: log_hr
tools.description: Append dated heart-rate figures: threshold, maximum, resting

tools.name: get_zones
tools.description: Power and HR zones from the figures in effect on a date

tools.name: add_event
tools.description: Record a race or objective — what the training is for

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Change an event's date, profile, priority or status

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Every objective, with the next A-event and the weeks to it

tools.name: record_race_result
tools.description: Close out a race: link the ride, store the finish time and the debrief

tools.name: import_activities
tools.description: Store raw Garmin MCP activity output, idempotent on activityId

tools.name: import_activity_laps
tools.description: Store one ride's splits in execution order

tools.name: annotate_activity
tools.description: Attach RPE, feel and notes to a ride

tools.name: list_activities
tools.description: Stored activities in a date range, with computed training load

tools.name: link_activity
tools.description: Attach the ride that happened to the session that was planned

tools.name: save_planned_workouts
tools.description: Store planned sessions as validated, renderable specs

tools.name: update_planned_workout
tools.description: Change a planned session: status, date, push target, or its spec

tools.name: get_week
tools.description: Plan against reality for a date range, and where they diverge

tools.name: compute_load
tools.description: Training load per ride, against the FTP in effect on its own date

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: CTL, ATL and TSB across a date range from the stored activities

tools.name: compliance_report
tools.description: What was prescribed against what was ridden, block by block

tools.name: export_data
tools.description: Dump the coaching database as JSON with a digest of the content

tools.name: import_data
tools.description: Restore the coaching database, refusing to overwrite by default

prompts.name: garmin-upload
prompts.description: Build a cycling workout and put it on Garmin Connect, verifying the result
prompts.text: Follow the "garmin-upload" procedure, using this server's tools. The full instructions are served by the server at run time; the session to build is ${arguments.session}.

prompts.name: mywhoosh-upload
prompts.description: Build a cycling workout and import it into MyWhoosh through the browser
prompts.text: Follow the "mywhoosh-upload" procedure, using this server's tools. The full instructions are served by the server at run time; the session to build is ${arguments.session}.

prompts.name: coaching
prompts.description: Coach an athlete: onboarding, the weekly plan, adaptation, the race debrief
prompts.text: Follow the "coaching" procedure, using this server's tools. The full instructions are served by the server at run time; what the athlete asked is ${arguments.session}.
